execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(
    mean_median_household_income = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_margin_of_error = mean(moe, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable != "total") |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    bachelors_or_higher_pct = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(bachelors_or_higher_pct))
```
